column1: # Crawl seeds — the categorized source catalog.
# Format:  source_id <TAB> url <TAB> trust <TAB> category <TAB> region <TAB> note
# trust:    A = established, edited, accountable | B = credible but narrower | C = user-generated
# category: news | government | education | health | science-tech | sport | culture | business | reference
# region:   dz = Algerian | global = rest of the world
# Trust is about accountability, not agreement or geography. Algeria-first is NOT enforced here — it
# lives in the ranker (any .dz host gets an authority home floor above an unlisted global one), so the
# global tier fills gaps and wins on relevance while a home site still takes a tie.
# Every entry is crawled under the open-web profile: robots.txt is obeyed, we identify as XustiveBot,
# one request per host at a time. A site that disallows us is simply not crawled — enforced in code.
# The giant reference/UGC platforms (Wikipedia beyond the Algeria portals, GitHub, Reddit, IMDb) are
# recognised by the authority list and pulled page-by-page by discovery, not bulk-seeded here.
# CULTURE (arts, film, TV, music, books, entertainment)
# Wikipedia seeded at the Algeria portals only — a crawler pointed at the front page would index the
# encyclopaedia of everything. The rest are bounded reference works.
# ADDITIONAL SOURCES (grouped by category in the UI regardless of position here)
# TOP-UP (to reach ~100 per category; grouped by category in the UI)
